how.startup: src/gui/tools/measure_startup.py on a copy of gui-startup-probe in a directory without a Telar/ folder, 3 warm-up rounds and 40 measured ones. Milliseconds from the spawn: main, root (Main.qml's window exists), frame (its first frame presented); qml is root minus the instant the controller was ready. median_interval is the distribution-free 95% interval of the median. Peak resident MiB from wait4.
how.cold_build: From an empty out/<preset>, timed and memory-sampled as tools/module-metrics.py does: configure; dependencies builds every library gui-quick links outside ui/ (unchanged by the experiment); qml_set builds telar-gui and gui-startup-probe, that is gui-quick, the QML module set and the two links.
how.incremental: Touch src/gui/ui/app/overlays/peek/peek_controller.cpp and rebuild, twice, after a build that brought the targets up to date. Debug builds every executable that links gui-quick (39); Release builds telar-gui and gui-startup-probe. Counts come from the build output.
how.module_set: From build.ninja: the static libraries, plugins, init and resource object libraries of gui-quick and every gui-ui-* target, their qmlcache and batch units, and the sizes of their archives and of telar-gui.
how.cold_build_alternated: The same steps as cold_build in out/fu5-cold-<preset>, with CPU time (user plus system of the whole build). Each campaign alternates the baseline and one variant, Debug then Release, for two rounds; campaign 1 compares peek, campaign 2 the middle option.
how.startup_comparison: measure_startup.py with the baseline probe first: rotating rounds, against_baseline is the median of the per-round differences (variant minus baseline, milliseconds or MiB) with its distribution-free 95% interval and the rounds in which the variant was faster.
